notes.subject: מנה אחת אפים
notes.rationale: Literal 'one portion of two faces/nostrils': 'double portion' (ASV/JPS) vs 'worthy/choice portion' (KJV/Geneva) vs 'portion angrily' — dual אפים kept as 'bilong tupela'.

notes.subject: bel bilong karim pikinini
notes.rationale: רחם is 'womb', literally shut up (סגר); Tok Pisin needs a phrase, not one word.

notes.subject: bilong em
notes.rationale: Suffix on רחמה supplied as separate pronoun phrase, Tok Pisin lacks pronominal suffixes.

translation: Na long Hana em i givim wanpela pes bilong tupela, bilong em i laikim ⟨את⟩ Hana, tasol Yahwe i pasim bel bilong karim pikinini bilong em.
